questions.question: The radius of the base of a right circular cone is 28 cm and its slant height is 13 cm. Find its lateral surface area. (Use pi = frac{22}7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the base of the cone (r) = 28 cm

Slant height of the cone (l) = 13 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Lateral Surface Area of a cone = π × r × l

**Calculation:**

Lateral Surface Area = π × r × l

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 22/7 × 28 × 13

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = (22 × 4) × 13

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 88 × 13

⇒ Lateral Surface Area = 1144 cm²

**The lateral surface area of the cone is 1144 cm².**

questions.question: The marked price of a speaker is ₹520 and the shopkeeper offers a discount of 10% and still he gains 17%. If no discount is allowed, then find the gain percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the speaker = ₹520

Discount = 10% of marked price

Gain when discount is allowed = 17%

**Formula Used:**

Discount = (Discount% × Marked Price) / 100

Selling Price = Marked Price - Discount

Cost Price = Selling Price / (1 + Gain%)

If no discount is allowed, Selling Price = Marked Price

Gain% = [(Selling Price - Cost Price) × 100] / Cost Price

**Calculation:**

Discount = (10 × 520) / 100

Discount = 52

Selling Price = Marked Price - Discount

Selling Price = 520 - 52

Selling Price = 468

Cost Price = Selling Price / (1 + Gain%)

Cost Price = 468 / (1 + 17/100)

Cost Price = 468 / 1.17

Cost Price = 400

If no discount is allowed:

Selling Price = Marked Price = 520

Gain% = [(Selling Price - Cost Price) × 100] / Cost Price

⇒ Gain% = [(520 - 400) × 100] / 400

⇒ Gain% = (120 × 100) / 400

⇒ Gain% = 30%

**The gain percentage when no discount is allowed is 30%.**

questions.question: A policeman travelling at a speed of 120 km/h chases a thief 5000 m away from him, and travelling at a speed of 100 km/h. What is the time taken by the policeman to catch the thief?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the policeman = 120 km/h

Speed of the thief = 100 km/h

Initial distance between policeman and thief = 5000 m

**Formula Used:**

Time taken to catch the thief = Distance / Relative Speed

Relative Speed = Speed of policeman - Speed of thief

**Calculation:**

Convert the distance into km:

Distance = 5000 m = 5000 / 1000 = 5 km

Calculate relative speed:

Relative Speed = 120 - 100

Relative Speed = 20 km/h

Time taken to catch the thief:

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 5 / 20

⇒ Time = 0.25 hours

Convert time into minutes:

Time = 0.25 × 60

⇒ Time = 15 minutes

**The time taken by the policeman to catch the thief is 15 minutes.**

questions.question: The height of a cylindrical pillar is 20 m. The diameter of its base is 350 cm. What will be the cost of painting the curved surface of the pillar at 40/m²? ( pi = (22)/(7) )
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Height of the cylindrical pillar (h) = 20 m.

Diameter of the base = 350 cm = 3.5 m (since 1 m = 100 cm).

Radius of the base (r) = Diameter / 2 = 3.5 / 2 = 1.75 m.

Cost of painting = ₹40 per m².

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = 2 × π × r × h.

Total cost of painting = CSA × Cost per m².

**Calculation:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × 22/7 × 1.75 × 20

⇒ CSA = 2 × 22 × 1.75 × 20 / 7

⇒ CSA = 2 × 22 × 35 / 7

⇒ CSA = 2 × 110

⇒ CSA = 220 m².

Total cost = CSA × Cost per m²

⇒ Total cost = 220 × 40

⇒ Total cost = ₹8,800.

**The cost of painting the curved surface of the pillar is ₹8,800.**

questions.question: Using the factor method of HCF, which of the following is the HCF of 160 and 256?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers: 160 and 256

**Formula Used:**

HCF using the factor method = Product of the common prime factors with the lowest powers.

**Calculation:**

Prime factorization of 160: 160 = 2⁵ × 5¹

Prime factorization of 256: 256 = 2⁸

Common prime factor: 2

Lowest power of common factor: 2⁵

HCF = 2⁵

⇒ HCF = 32

**The HCF of 160 and 256 is 32.**

questions.question: In a hospital, 60% of the patients are men, 25% of the patients are women, and 15% of the patients are children. If the average age of the men is 40 years, that of the women is 36 years, and that of the children is 8 years. What is the average age of all the patients?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of men = 60%

Percentage of women = 25%

Percentage of children = 15%

Average age of men = 40 years

Average age of women = 36 years

Average age of children = 8 years

**Formula Used:**

Weighted Average = (Sum of (Percentage × Average) for all groups}) / 100

**Calculation:**

Weighted Average = (60 × 40 + 25 × 36 + 15 × 8) / 100

Step-by-step calculation:

⇒ Weighted Average = (2400 + 900 + 120) / 100

⇒ Weighted Average = 3420 / 100

⇒ Weighted Average = 34.2

**The average age of all the patients is 34.2 years.**

questions.question: In an election there were only two candidates, Geeta and Shyama. Geeta received 15% of the total votes and Shyama received 8700 votes. 60% of the voters did not cast their vote to either of the two candidates. Find the total percentage of votes that Shyama received, assuming that all the votes cast were valid.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Geeta received 15% of the total votes.

Shyama received 8700 votes.

60% of the voters did not cast their vote to either of the two candidates.

All the votes cast were valid.

**Formula Used:**

Total votes = Votes received by Geeta + Votes received by Shyama + Votes not cast.

Percentage of votes received by Shyama = (Votes received by Shyama / Total votes) × 100.

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of votes be V .

Votes cast to Geeta = 15% of total votes = 0.15V

Votes not cast = 60% of total votes = 0.60V

Votes cast to Shyama = 8700.

From the formula:

Total votes = Votes received by Geeta + Votes received by Shyama + Votes not cast.

⇒ V = 0.15V + 8700 + 0.60V

⇒ V - 0.15V - 0.60V = 8700

⇒ 0.25V = 8700

⇒ V = 8700 / 0.25

⇒ V = 34800

Total votes = 34800.

Percentage of votes received by Shyama:

⇒ (Votes received by Shyama / Total votes) × 100

⇒ (8700 / 34800) × 100

⇒ 0.25 × 100

⇒ 25%

**Shyama received 25% of the total votes.**
